00044 AmplitudeUGenInternal::AmplitudeUGenInternal(UGen const& input) throw()
00045 : UGenInternal(NumInputs)
00046 {
00047  inputs[Input] = input;
00048  
00049  measureLength = UGen::getSampleRate() * 0.01;
00050  measuredItems = 0;
00051  maximum = 0.f;
00052  oldMaximum = 0.f;
00053  currentAmplitude = 0.f;
00054 }
00055 
00056 void AmplitudeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00057 {
00058  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00059  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00060  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00061  
00062  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00063  {
00064   float input = *inputSamples;
00065   
00066   if(abs(input) > maximum) 
00067    maximum = abs(input);
00068   
00069   measuredItems++;
00070   
00071   if(measuredItems == measureLength)
00072   {
00073    currentAmplitude = maximum;
00074    measuredItems = 0;
00075    maximum = 0.f;
00076   }
00077   
00078   float output = currentAmplitude;
00079   
00080   *outputSamples = output;
00081   
00082   outputSamples++;
00083   inputSamples++;
00084  }
00085 }
00086 
00087 Amplitude::Amplitude(UGen const& input) throw()
00088 {
00089  initInternal(input.getNumChannels());
00090  
00091  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00092  {
00093   internalUGens[i] = new AmplitudeUGenInternal(input);
00094  }
00095 }
